title: Prayag India Production Planning & Operations
description: One operating layer for demand, capacity, machine feasibility, and corrective action.

title: The operating challenge
description: Issued demand, distributed inputs, and machine constraints require one traceable operating view.

title: What the app changes
description: The product separates demand owed from executable production and preserves decision lineage.

title: One workflow, from source to action
description: A governed loop from ingest and validation through planning, release, monitoring, and corrective replanning.

title: Two numbers that must stay separate
description: Issued demand and executable plan are different quantity bases, with deferred and unfulfillable quantities explicit.

title: A governed data foundation
description: Source identity, capture evidence, reconciliation, and failed validations remain visible.

title: Planning workspace
description: A month- and segment-aware workspace for catalogue, stock, pending orders, demand, and governed baselines.

title: Capacity intelligence, not just totals
description: Capacity methods use historical evidence and expose variation and limitations.

title: From category plan to machine release
description: Category plans are cascaded through machine constraints and weekly release windows.

title: Monitoring the plan in motion
description: Plan, actuals, run rate, remaining demand, RAG, and governing plans stay connected.

title: Corrective action with lineage
description: Corrective replans start from frozen baselines and export persisted results with lineage.

title: PTMT: item-and-colour planning
description: PTMT retains item and colour identity from governed inputs through machine execution.

title: Plumbing: category-to-machine planning
description: Plumbing planning connects product families, workbook evidence, and machine cascades.

title: Guardrails that protect decisions
description: Structural, freshness, lineage, baseline, and classification guardrails prevent silent errors.

title: Administration and accountability
description: Access, audit, source configuration, and plan history make operational decisions reviewable.

title: What a decision looks like in practice
description: The app turns production questions into explicit demand, capacity, release, and baseline decisions.

title: The result: one source of operational truth
description: Planning, execution, corrective change, and historical reporting share one operating language.

title: Next operating priorities
description: The next priorities strengthen Plumbing reconciliation, staleness protection, independent evidence approval, and end-to-end scheduling.
